messages:
ajay.khanna: Heads up — AWS channel invoice 49321 got auto-HOLD during marketplace settlement. Customer: CloudCloud LLC. Reason in portal: missing reseller endorsement. Need unblock to hit month-end revenue. Anyone from finance/legal online?

billing-bot: Invoice 49321 status changed to HOLD by ruleset MARKETPLACE_ENDORSEMENT_MISSING. Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/49321 :no_entry_sign:

maya.patel: ugh — we shipped seats + metered storage. Did the reseller send their endorsement letter for March? I have a reconciliation stub showing 72,430 usage units vs expected 72,430 ok. but endorsement missing.

liam.parker: can you paste the invoice lines? I want to check GL and tax codes before we release.

ajay.khanna: here's a snippet: ```
Line 1: CloudCloud LLC - AWS Marketplace - subscriptions - SKU: RW-MKT-SUB - Qty: 1200 seats - Amount: $36,000 - GL: 4101
Line 2: CloudCloud LLC - AWS Marketplace - storage - SKU: RW-MKT-STO - Usage 72430 GB - Amount: $7,243 - GL: 4110
Tax: $3,885
Invoice total: $47,128
```

maya.patel: GLs look ok. The delta from last month is the seat uplift (1200 vs 1100). We need reseller endorsement confirming they co-sell and allowed resale pricing, per AWS MP rules.

tara.lee: legal here. We'll need: 1) reseller endorsement letter on company letterhead signed by partner exec; 2) copy of the partner's AWS Marketplace seller ID; 3) confirmation of pricing channel (resale vs referral). If we get those, legal can approve a release. ETA 24h after receipt. :balance_scale:

ajay.khanna: partner says they'll send but asks for the invoice to be released earlier if we can apply a provisional endorsement receipt and flag for audit. Is that allowed?

tara.lee: we cannot remove HOLD without the signed letter. Provisional confirmations via email from partner BD are not sufficient for marketplace compliance. We can do a manual escrow credit hold release if finance signs off and we note audit trail. Need C-suite sign-off for the risk. :no_good:

liam.parker: finance: can you approve provisional release pending signed doc? risk is small but affects recognition in Q1 close.

maya.patel: finance POV: if we release, we should create a flagged journal entry and reverse if no letter in 30 days. I can prepare a memo and accounting tag. Need a pm or CRO sign-off.

ajay.khanna: assigning to @carly.wong (CRO) for sign-off. Carly, can you OK provisional release with flagged JE? It will let bookings hit month close.

billing-bot: Note: any manual release will trigger audit annotation: MANUAL_MARKETPLACE_RELEASE by user ajay.khanna.

tara.lee: also attach the partner's reseller agreement excerpt and the AWS MP policy citation to the ticket. I'll review once docs arrive.

carly.wong: (via DM, posted here) I can approve provisional release with flagged JE + 30-day return clause. Carly signs off. :white_check_mark:

ajay.khanna: thanks. maya, liam — please coordinate the JE and release. I'll add partner on Cc for the signed letter.

maya.patel: will do. creating JE now and releasing invoice. will tag audit and legal ticket.

liam.parker: releasing the invoice now per Carly's ok. Manual note added. :rocket:

billing-bot: Invoice 49321 status updated to RELEASED_MANUAL by liam.parker at 2412345762. Audit ref: MANREL-2026-49321.
